name: Umbra's Rage
disable: DC 26 Religion check (expert) to exorcise the closest spirits or DC 30 Diplomacy check (expert) to calm them down

items.name: Curse of Eternal Battle
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters combat while in Umbra's Last Stand

---
Effect The creature must attempt a DC 26 Will save save as the rage of the surrounding orcs threatens to overwhelm them.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Stupefied 1 for 1 round.

Failure The creature is Confused for 1 round.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is confused for 1 minute.

text: The anger of the fallen Umbra Legion seeps into any creature entering combat.
